article.story: BALTIMORE -- — DJ Armstrong had 22 points in UMBC's 79-56 win over UMass-Lowell on Saturday. Armstrong shot 7 of 12 from the field, including 5 for 8 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 3 from the line for the Retrievers (12-7, 5-1 America East Conference). Josh Odunowo added 17 points and Jah'likai King scored 10. Austin Green led the River Hawks (8-13, 3-3) in scoring, finishing with 14 points and six rebounds. Victor Okojie added 12 points for UMass-Lowell. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
